source: HDR, Pinole/Hercules WPCP TM 15 Hydraulic Profile (March 2013): Executive Summary 'Conclusions' (PDF p.3-4), 'Recommended Project' (p.10) and Table 15-4 'Unit Process Design Constraints' (p.11); notes column of Appendix A. Withheld from the agent.
question: Can the upgraded Pinole/Hercules WPCP pass 20 mgd PWWF through secondary treatment, what limits, and what fixes?

items.unit: Primary clarifiers / primary clarifier distribution box
items.engineers: Existing primary clarifiers lack wet-weather capacity: hydraulic capacity about 12 mgd; flow above 12 mgd (8 mgd at PWWF) bypasses the primaries through the 30-in bypass to the Primary Effluent Junction Box. Primary clarifier weir inverts are adequate (114.25 ft) but should be field verified and reset if needed; distribution box needs no modification.
leak_phrases: do not have capacity to handle wet weather flows
invert of the primary clarifier weirs is adequate

items.engineers: Existing box lacks capacity (short weirs, high headloss, poor split). Build a new box with five weirs set at 110.00 ft (two 7-ft weirs to new SC 1 and 2, three 2.5-ft weirs to existing SC 3-5) giving correct split and limiting secondary-system headloss.
leak_phrases: New box will limit the headloss through the secondary system

items.engineers: Replace the 30-in aeration basin effluent pipe with a 36-in pipe to minimize headloss; operate basins in contact stabilization (RAS to Zone A, primary effluent to Zones D/E, step-feed ports opened/retrofitted, MLR off) at PWWF.
leak_phrases: 30-IN effluent pipe will be replaced with 36-IN pipe

items.engineers: Reinstall existing secondary clarifier weirs with invert raised to 109.30 ft to handle 20 mgd; two new 65-ft clarifiers take 60 percent of the flow.
leak_phrases: Weir elevations will be raised to 109.30

items.engineers: With the new distribution box and two new secondary clarifiers, the plant runs at all four scenarios with no hydraulic issues and at least 1 ft between water surface and top of concrete at every unit; secondary system can treat up to 20 mgd.
leak_phrases: secondary system will be able to treat up to 20

items.engineers: Re-use existing chlorine contact basins; no hydraulic modifications (effluent weir 107.15 ft, 4.5 ft long, about 1 ft head at 10 mgd per basin).
leak_phrases: Re-use existing infrastructure, no hydraulic modifications
